notices: Node 'triage' declared with at 30, which 31 has no member for; its values are written at the end of its prompt, as 30's engine sent them.

texts.explanation: sent-format: the format appended to the prompt is 30's as § 1.8 rewrites it: every property required, an optional one nullable, written in canonical order, with the descriptions 31 sends where 30's had none; or a classifier's answers, the values 30 listed, sent as its format after them (part 10 § 1.8 (every property required, an optional one nullable); R12 and #1508, comment 5, item 7, #3, ruled by the owner on 2026-11-25 (a format's description sent; a classifier's answers sent as its format); part 10 § 3.2)
